nota: Here you register the account's properties and doors. Then the ESP32 is linked to each door; the account administrator can rename or disable them from the app.
sitioNombreAyuda: The place where the doors are: “Head office”, “North plant”…
zonaAyuda: Access schedules and the end of a QR's day are calculated with this zone.
puertaNombreAyuda: How people know it: “Main gate”, “Service door”…
segundosAyuda: How long the lock stays open on each pulse, from {{min}} to {{max}} seconds.
segundosInvalidos: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
puertaActiva: Door enabled (otherwise it rejects all access)
quitarSitioTexto: Only a property without doors can be deleted. It is kept in the audit log.
quitarPuertaTexto: If it has a reader in service, it must be decommissioned first. QR codes that included it stop opening it.
sinPuertas: This property has no doors yet.
vacioTexto: Create the first property and then add its doors.
